review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse backend S3 client lifecycle and connection leak prevention
review.reason: The change replaces an explicit close of an S3 client with a proper context manager exit (`__aexit__`) and adds a unit test asserting this cleanup behavior. This prevents HTTP connection leaks in long-lived warehouse workers, a substantive reliability improvement.
